contexts.text: For a memorial before Jehovah continually () = from mercy to eternity.
Upon his heart before Jehovah continually () = perpetually shining forth from good... Continually = perpetually.
It shall be upon the forehead of Aaron continually () = a representative of the Lord's love to eternity... Continually = to eternity. Explained.
By the Continual is signified in special the daily sacrifice, and in all general, worship. AC 10133. AC 10133:2. AC 10143. AC 10203.
The Continual, in the Word, = all representative worship.
